Hi Alex — thanks again for a great discovery this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps:

- Goal: a 60–90 minute technical workshop with our ML/infra team to validate latency/cost assumptions and go over deployment options (hosted vs. dedicated vs. private).
- Success criteria you mentioned: sub-200ms p50 for short completion paths, predictable batch throughput for async embeddings jobs, and audit/log retention for compliance.

Proposed next step: a 60–90 minute technical deep dive with our infra leads (So o jin and Marissa) to walk through sample traffic, model sizes, and an initial rollout plan. Can you share 2–3 windows next week that work on your side? I can then align Soojin and Marissa.

Preliminary agenda (flexible):
1) 10 min — intros & discovery highlights
2) 25–35 min — workload profile & performance targets (Alex + OrbitAI)
3) 25–35 min — Redwood runtime architecture, routing, and quantization trade-offs (Soojin)
4) 10–15 min — rollout options, SLA/cost trade-offs (Marissa + Jonas)
5) 5–10 min — action items & ops preflight checklist

Attaching a one-page agenda and a short preflight checklist we typically ask customers to fill out before the deep dive. No need to complete everything, but traffic shape and model sizes are the highest-value fields for the session.

Best,
